verdict.rationale: Missive has an in-app AI Assistant that runs long sessions, answers how-to questions from the docs, and creates drafts. Through its official MCP server, external AI apps like Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor can act on conversations, contacts, calendar, and drafts via natural-language prompts such as "summarize your inbox and draft replies." The built-in assistant requires the user's own Anthropic, OpenAI, or Gemini API key. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of the full range of in-app actions the assistant can perform (beyond drafting and doc answers), and independent or hands-on corroboration of natural-language operation.
